description: Routing accuracy corpus — phrases that should/should not activate skills-refactor. The hard boundary the adversarials target: skills-refactor RESTRUCTURES an existing skill (rename / merge / retire / split + rewire the library) vs skills-studio, which works on a skill's CONTENT (author / edit / optimize / score / critique).
trigger_phrases: rename skill X to Y and fix all the references
merge skills A and B into one
split X into A and B
drop the core- prefix from this skill
rewire all the cross-references after renaming this skill
absorb X's capability into Y and retire X
combine the two evaluator skills into one
this skill should be renamed — update peer_skills and the catalog
adversarial_phrases: create a new skill for writing database migrations
fix a bug in this skill's instructions
improve this skill's description so it routes better
score this skill against best practices
run the critics on this skill
audit my repo's docs and skills for drift
notes: Adversarials route to siblings: create/fix/optimize/score/critique a skill → skills-studio (the single-skill lifecycle — content, not structure); build a domain-expert skill → meta-expert-author; repo doc/skill drift audit → ops-repo. skills-refactor owns the library-level structural ops (rename/merge/retire/split) and the cross-reference rewire + gate re-verification they require.
